influences.name: Bessie Smith
influences.context: Joplin's Texas roots connected her to blues legends like Bessie Smith, whom she idolized.

influences.name: Kris Kristofferson
influences.context: 'Me and Bobby McGee' – with the famous line 'Freedom's just another word for nothing left to lose' – topped charts posthumously. Written by Kris Kristofferson, it became an anthem for anyone chasing dreams.
